subject: Final confirmation: HealthWave will not permit customer data for model training — onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthwave.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-01T15:12:00Z
Subject: Post-demo follow-up & data-handling confirmation (next steps)

Hi Samir / Elena —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and the commitments we discussed so you can share this with your security/legal folks: 

- Decision: HealthWave confirms it does NOT want any customer data used to train or improve Redwood models (no fine-tuning, no tuning jobs, no gradients, no data ingestion for model updates).
- Logging: Redwood will retain request/response logs for troubleshooting only and apply a 14-day retention for verbatim payloads. Logs will be archived in an access-controlled bucket for 90 days (metadata-only retained longer).
- PII handling: We will enable request-side scrubbing rules you provided (PII token masking) and add the header X-HW-PII-MASK: true on all HealthWave calls.
- KV / cache: Session KV cache will be isolated and NOT persisted to training datasets; we will not export KV caches for any learning pipelines.
- Residency: Production inference will run in us-west-2; backups and logs subject to the retention above.

Next steps I’ll take this week:
1) Share a DPA-draft and SOC2 evidence bundle (see attachments).
2) Create a HubSpot task for legal review and generate a mutual action plan with target dates.
3) Send a short ops playbook that lists the Redaction rules and the X-HW headers so your engineers can validate.

Can you confirm the wording above matches HealthWave's expectation? If yes, reply with a one-line confirmation and I’ll route the DPA to your procurement team.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai

Attachments: HealthWave-SOC2-evidence.pdf (stub), DPA-draft-HealthWave.docx (stub)
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthwave.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novushealth.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up & data-handling confirmation (next steps)

Sofia —

Confirmation from our side: the bulleted points match HealthWave's requirement. To be explicit: 
- No training or model improvement using HealthWave customer content.
- 14-day verbatim retention, 90-day archival for access-controlled diagnostics only.
- PII must be masked per the scrubbing rules (we will share the last set of patterns).

Please proceed with the DPA and include the specific header names (X-HW-PII-MASK, X-HW-ENV). Once legal gets the DPA we’ll aim to return redlines within 5 business days.

—Samir
Samir Patel
VP Product, HealthWave
samir.patel@healthwave.io
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@healthwave.io>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-02T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up & data-handling confirmation (ops items)

Thanks Samir — appreciate the quick confirmation. Internal ops notes / commitments: 

- DPA: Sofia, I attached an editable DPA (DPA-draft-HealthWave.docx). I’ll add the explicit clause: “Customer data will not be used to train, fine-tune, or otherwise improve models serving Redwood Inference or its affiliates.”
- Headers & scrubber: Aditya will deploy the X-HW headers and enable the HealthWave scrubber rule set to the production rule engine by 2027-12-03 23:59 PST.
- Telemetry: We will disable diagnostic telemetry that captures request bodies for HealthWave’s tenant ID. Diagnostic traces will include request IDs but not verbatim user content.
- Audit: SOC2 evidence bundle attached for your security team review; I’ll grant view-only Drive access to the contact you list.

Operational validation plan: once Aditya has deployed the scrubbers, we will run a short smoke test using a masked payload you provide and share the trace IDs. We will also add a line item to the mutual action plan in HubSpot (link below).

HubSpot task created: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/537
Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/abc123

Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up & data-handling confirmation (ops items)

Thanks all — this is perfect and aligns with what legal needs. We’ll review the DPA and return any redlines by EOD 2027-12-08. Please go ahead with the scrubber rollout and share one smoke-test trace ID when ready.

Elena Ruiz
